# SS Mugs (ssmugs.com)

> SS Mugs (ssmugs.com) is a professional stainless steel mugs factory in China. We supply wholesale and bulk-order B2B OEM/ODM insulated drinkware — vacuum insulated, double-wall stainless steel bottles, tumblers, car cups, coffee cups, lids and more — to distributors and private-label brands in Europe and Poland. Competitive price, low MOQ, direct sale, fast lead time.

## Company
- Name: SS Mugs
- Website: https://ssmugs.com
- Type: Stainless steel insulated drinkware manufacturer / factory
- Location: China (Zhejiang)
- Contact: bob@ssmugs.com · Tel +86 579 86465870 · Mobile / WhatsApp +86 150 8822 8843
- Business model: Wholesale, bulk order, B2B, OEM / ODM, private label, direct sale, competitive price, low MOQ.

## Products (Stainless Steel Insulated Drinkware)
- Capacity range: 350ml, 500ml, 600ml, 750ml, 1000ml+ across 35+ series.
- Materials: 304 food-grade stainless steel (inner wall), 201 (outer wall), BPA-free, double-wall vacuum insulation for heat and cold retention.
- Lines: Pastoral bottle, Straight bottle, Diamond bottle, Gourd bottle, Milk bottle, Cola bottle, Round tumbler, Narrow-mouth bottle, Single-wall bottle, Vacuum (cola) bottle, Wide-mouth bottle, Car cup (Gen 1/2/3), Bottle lid, Can-style bottle, Coffee cup, Egg cup, Temp-display bottle, 3-in-1 bottle, Bullet bottle, Slim waist bottle.
- [Product Catalog (EN)](https://ssmugs.com/en/products): full specs, ex-work pricing and carton data for every series.
- [Product Catalog (PL)](https://ssmugs.com/pl/products): this same catalog in Polish for the Polish B2B market.

## OEM / ODM Capabilities
- Custom logo: laser engraving, 3D emboss, silk-screen, sublimation, water-transfer.
- Colors & finish: spray paint (matte/gloss), rubber coat, powder coat, electro-polish.
- Lids & accessories: straw lid, flip lid, press lid, wide-mouth, sport cap — 50+ cap models.
- Molds & shape: new molds developed for exclusive shapes and capacities.
- Packaging: white box, color box, display box, mailer — branded.
- Lead time: 7–15 days for standard items; samples in 3–5 days.

## Why choose SS Mugs
- Vertically integrated stainless steel mugs factory — no middlemen, transparent ex-work pricing.
- Proven exporter to European markets, including Poland, with private-label experience.
- In-house molding, welding, painting, printing and assembly with strict per-carton QC (weight, seal, insulation retention).
- Flexible MOQ that supports pilot runs for new brands.
